hypothesis: Replacing layer-based bidirectional BFS with deterministic A* using Manhattan distance as an admissible heuristic will reduce total nodes explored on the fixed maze suite while preserving shortest-path correctness.
implementation_summary: Replaced bidirectional BFS with heap-based A* using Manhattan distance, fixed neighbor order, deterministic priority tie-breaking, stale-entry skipping, and parent reconstruction when the goal is removed from the queue.
